title: df -J record
description: One file system reported by `df -J`. A file system df cannot read has no numbers. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

filesystem.description: The source: the device or remote file system, as the mount table names it (`total` for the --total row).

mount_bytes.description: The bytes of `mount`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`mount` then holds the lossy form).

path.description: The operand that selected this file system, when one did.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

used.description: Bytes used (negative when the reserved space is over-committed).

use_percent.description: GNU's Use%: used / (used + available), rounded up.
